name: Ennore Oil Spill — Historical Validation Investigation
region: Bay of Bengal — Ennore / Chennai coast
description: On 28 January 2017, BW Maple and Dawn Kancheepuram collided near Ennore Port, Tamil Nadu, releasing fuel oil that reached approximately 35 km of Chennai coastline. This case is used as a HISTORICAL VALIDATION incident to demonstrate the PALEGIC investigation workflow using publicly documented facts and illustrative/training data. No live or classified data are used.
provenance_note: All facts in this file are sourced from published news reports and maritime incident databases. This prototype does not possess primary evidence; the investigation serves only as a methodology demonstration.
